## What changes?

Describe the behavior and the smallest supported workflow.

## Validation

List commands actually run, including skips and resource limitations.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the changed formulas, state, or workflow.
- [ ] New comments/docstrings are English and explain non-obvious decisions.
- [ ] Unsupported combinations are explicit.
- [ ] Primary references and required notices are preserved.
- [ ] No private data, credentials, model weights, or generated runs are included.
- [ ] Performance or quality claims have reproducible evidence.
